data.one_liner: Easy-to-use responsive tools and grid layouts for Flutter screens.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools for creating responsive layouts using breakpoints, including a ResponsiveLayout widget, utility values, a 12-column responsive grid system, and fluid typography.
use_when: You want to build adaptable layouts across multiple screen sizes using custom or default breakpoints.
You need a Bootstrap-style 12-column responsive grid system.
You want to dynamically adjust values or widget properties based on screen width or height.
avoid_when: You already use another comprehensive responsive framework and want to avoid overlapping design paradigms.
You only need simple media query checks without layout helpers.
strengths: Includes responsive layout widgets, value adapters, custom breakpoints, a grid system, and fluid typography.
Supports constraint-based layouts in addition to full screen size checks.
Allows custom breakpoint extensions and naming conventions.
weaknesses: Relies on manual layout adjustments per breakpoint rather than automatic scaling of the entire UI.
Pre-release versioning (0.0.6) indicates the API might change.

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer automatic UI scaling and a robust global responsive configuration rather than custom widget builders.

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer standard screen-type enum builders (mobile, tablet, desktop) out of the box.

alternatives.name: sizer
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want simpler percentage-based sizing extensions for text and dimensions.

data.minimal_example:
ResponsiveLayout(
  Breakpoints(
    xs: Text('xs'),
    sm: Text('sm'),
    md: Text('md'),
    lg: Text('lg'),
    xl: Text('xl'),
    xxl: Text('xxl'),
  ),
)
